summary: Bind analyzer snapshots to observed tool implementation bytes

delivery.outcome: Bind analyzer observations to bounded installed package-byte fingerprints without imports and prevent installed bytecode caches from shadowing observed sources. Preserve the previous snapshot on same-version code drift; tested independent publication.
nonGoals: No package installation/update, new standard adoption, CI/hooks/permissions edit or dependency
Preserve active author045 SSOT CLI and all foreign work

architecture.decision: Extend existing environment-before/after artifacts and environment digests with actual analyzer package bytes; use fresh bytecode lookup and no cache writes. Dependency versions remain metadata, not immutable dependency bytes or conformance evidence.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of additive scope correction.

validation.evidence: Real isolated implementation probes, stale bytecode isolation, bounded package reads and prior-snapshot preservation.
Full test and governance gates; independent exact-head review and merge.
